svg.title: recusal: the gate sits between the proposed call and the tool
svg.desc: An agent proposes a tool call. The gate, your policy with no model in it, decides before the tool runs. With no objection the tool runs. On a failing finding, or when the policy itself raises, the call is refused: the tool never runs and the reason goes back to the model. Every decision can be written to a hash-chained audit log.

svg.text: THE BUILDER DOES NOT GRADE ITS OWN WORK
